## Multiple Choice Questions

**1.** Which of the following describes continuous monitoring, as distinct from continuous auditing?

A.  Internal audit's yearly test of a sample of transactions
B.  The external auditor's review of controls at year-end
C.  Management's ongoing review of whether its own controls operate
D.  A report of key performance indicators prepared for the board each quarter

**2.** In the framework of Kogan et al. (2014), a purchase order approved above its approver's limit fails a deterministic business rule. What does such a test produce?

A.  An exception
B.  An anomaly
C.  A false positive
D.  A near-duplicate

**3.** Gonzalez and Hoffman (2018) studied the prompt notification of auditees about the transactions a monitoring system flagged. What did they find when the monitoring system was weak?

A.  Notification reduced fraud by a large margin in every condition
B.  Notification had no effect on behavior
C.  Notification mainly increased false positives
D.  Notification increased the inclination to commit fraud

**4.** A query has five flag columns, each 1 or 0, and you need one row per flag with the flag's name and value. Which Power Query command produces that?

A.  Merge Queries with the Employee table
B.  Unpivot Only Selected Columns
C.  Append Queries as New
D.  Group By with the Advanced option

**5.** Before appending the exceptions, a colleague renamed the columns of the journal entry and payroll queries but left the purchase order query's date column named OrderDate. What does the appended register contain?

A.  An OrderDate column of its own, with EventDate empty for orders
B.  An error that stops the query until the column names match exactly
C.  The order dates under EventDate, because the columns are in the same order
D.  No purchase order rows, because Append drops tables whose columns differ

**6.** Why does the monitoring model keep the journal entries, purchase orders, and payroll registers as tables of their own beside the exception register?

A.  The register cannot be related to the Date table
B.  Power BI requires every unpivoted table to stay loaded
C.  The rates divide each test's exceptions by its population
D.  The drill-through page reads documents only from those tables

**7.** On the monitoring page, most tests show exceptions only in January, while one test shows exceptions in every month of every year. Which reading is most appropriate?

A.  The Date table assigns the recurring test's dates incorrectly
B.  A design flaw in the control behind the recurring test
C.  The January cluster is more serious because it is larger
D.  The recurring test should be removed as a source of noise

**8.** Why does Tutorial 16.3 keep the dispositions in a table of their own, merged into the register, rather than in a column typed beside the register's rows?

A.  A table visual cannot show text and numbers in the same row
B.  A merged column refreshes faster than one typed beside the rows
C.  Only a separate table can be hidden from the report's readers
D.  The merge reattaches each conclusion after every refresh

**9.** After the merge, one exception from this month's refresh has a null Disposition. What is it?

A.  An exception that a reviewer has marked as expected
B.  An open exception, still awaiting review
C.  A document missing from the population of its process
D.  A disposition whose document number was mistyped

**10.** A reviewer has time for one exception today. Following Li et al. (2016) and Chapter 8's risk score, which should come first?

A.  A new exception on a document that fails three tests
B.  One of the year-end closing entries above every approval limit
C.  One of the registers approved by the employee they pay
D.  The oldest open exception in the register, from January 2024

**11.** Seventy-seven registers, spread over every month, fail the test of pay approved by the employee being paid. How should the review report them?

A.  As seventy-seven exceptions, each with its own follow-up question
B.  As false positives, because the approver is the accounting manager
C.  As one finding on the design of the control
D.  As expected exceptions that need no attention in later months

**12.** The Data Through card shows December 18, 2026, although the journal entries and the purchase orders run to December 31. What does it mean?

A.  The refresh failed for two of the three populations
B.  The journal entries after December 18 were backdated
C.  The Date table of the monitoring file ends on December 18
D.  The payroll tests have not seen the last days of the year

**13.** Which practice lets a reviewer see exactly which lines of a measure or query a change altered before the report is published?

A.  Keeping the report as a project under version control
B.  Applying a sensitivity label to the report in Power BI Desktop
C.  Adding a page navigator and an About page to the report
D.  Emailing each new version of the .pbix file to the reviewer

**14.** A department manager asks for a copy of Charles River Reports.pbix to work with offline. Why should internal audit object?

A.  A copy cannot be opened without a Power BI Pro license
B.  It holds every row and escapes change control
C.  The copy's measures are recalculated by a different engine
D.  The copy loses its Tests tab and the queries saved in it
